title: Running Commentary on Torah 31 — Is Lan Beira b'Dvara
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 31 — אית לן בירא בדברא
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **The ma'amar**: **'Amru lei: is lan beira b'dvara, ileih l'masa! Aiti pa'arei, shada l'hu. Amar l'hu: afshilu li chavlei d'pa'arei, v'a'ileih. Amru lei: u'mi ika d'mafshil chavlei mi'pa'arei? Amar l'hu: u'mi ika d'maiti beira mi'dvara l'masa?'** — 'They said to him: we have a **well in the wilderness** — bring it into the city! He brought them **bran (pa'arei)** and threw it to them. He said: **spin me ropes of bran**, and I will bring it. They said: who can spin ropes of bran? He said: who can bring a well from the wilderness to the city?' (Bechoros 8b.)

intermediate.en: **Bechoros 8b**: "bring our well from wilderness to city!" R"Y threw **pa'arei (bran)** → "spin ropes of bran." Mutual absurdity: ropes of bran impossible; carrying a well impossible.
intermediate.he: **בכורות ח:**: "הביאו בירנו מהמדבר לעיר" → ר"י השליך **פארי (סובין)** → "עשו לי חבלי סובין". אבסורד הדדי.

beginner.en: **Rashi**: **pa'arei** = bran (husks). 'Make me a rope from husks; if you cannot fulfill my request, I too cannot fulfill yours.'

intermediate.en: Rashi: pa'arei=bran; if you can't do mine, I can't do yours.
intermediate.he: רש"י: פארי=סובין; אם אינכם עושים שאלתי, גם אני לא.

beginner.en: **"Leshon Rabbeinu z"l"**

intermediate.en: **Leshon Rabbeinu z"l**
intermediate.he: **לשון רבנו ז"ל**

beginner.en: **"א. **Tzedakah is bechina of galgalim** (the heavenly spheres) — Chazal (Shabbos 151b): **'ki bi'glal ha'davar ha'zeh, galgal hu ha'chozeir ba'olam'** (Devarim 15:10 — 'wheel that turns in the world'). Tzedakah has **6 brachos + 11 brachos** (Bava Basra 9b): **'ha'nosein prutah l'ani, misbareich b'shesh berachos; v'ha'm'fayso bi'dvarim, misbareich b'achas esreih'** — corresponding to the **7 kochvei lechet** and **12 mazalos**. Tzedakah steers all the galgalei ha'rakia: **'derech ha'nesher ba'shamayim'** (Mishlei 30:19). **Nesher = rachamim** (Zohar Yisro 80)."**

intermediate.en: **α. Tzedakah=galgalim** (Shab 151b "galgal ha'chozeir"). 6+11 brachos (BB 9b)=7 kochvei lechet+12 mazalos. Steers all galgalei ha'rakia (Mishlei 30:19 "derech ha'nesher ba'shamayim"; nesher=rachamim, Zohar Yisro 80).
intermediate.he: **α. צדקה=גלגלים** (שב' קנא: "גלגל החוזר"). ו'+י"א ברכות (ב"ב ט:)=ז' כוכבי לכת+י"ב מזלות. מנהיג כל גלגלי הרקיע (מש' ל, יט "דרך הנשר"; נשר=רחמים, זוה"ק יתרו פ).

scholarly.he: סעיף א. שב' קנא:; ב"ב ט:; מש' ל, יט; זוה"ק יתרו פ.

beginner.en: **"ב. Why only 17 brachos (6+11) instead of 19 (7+12)? There should be 7+12. The answer:**

intermediate.en: **β. Why 6+11 and not 7+12? Answer below.**
intermediate.he: **ב. מדוע ו'+י"א ולא ז'+י"ב? תשובה בהמשך.**

beginner.en: **"Know: ikkar shleimus of the galgalim = shleimus of tzedakah **only on Shabbos**. **'Shemesh b'Shabbos tzedakah l'aniyim'** (Ta'anis 8b) — tzedakah has no shleimus-illumination except via Shabbos. Through Shabbos she shines k'shemesh — **'shemesh tzedakah'** (Mal'achi 3:20)."** **"Mishnah (beginning of Shabbos): **'yetzi'os ha'Shabbos shtayim she'hein arba'** — right after: **'pashat he'ani'** (the poor man extended his hand). Ikkar **hisnotzetzus or ha'tzedakah** = only on Shabbos."** **"Ikkar chashivus ha'tzedakah = **emunah** — **'v'he'emin ba'Hashem'** (Bereshis 15:6). **Shabbos = emunah** (as known). Hence the missing 1+1 comes via Shabbos."**

intermediate.en: **Shleimus tzedakah only on Shabbos** ("shemesh b'Shabbos tzedakah l'aniyim," Ta'an 8b; "shemesh tzedakah," Mal 3:20). Mishnah Shab opens "yetzi'os ha'Shabbos... pashat he'ani." Ikkar chashivus=**emunah** ("v'he'emin," Ber 15:6); Shabbos=emunah.
intermediate.he: **שלמות צדקה רק בשבת** ("שמש בשבת צדקה לעניים", תענ' ח:; "שמש צדקה", מל' ג, כ). משנה שב': "יציאות השבת... פשט העני". עיקר חשיבות=**אמונה** ("והאמין", בר' טו, ו); שבת=אמונה.

scholarly.he: תענ' ח:; מל' ג, כ; בר' טו, ו.

beginner.en: **"ג. **Kiyum of emunah only via bris**: **'u'vrisi ne'emenes lo'** (Tehillim 89:29). Bris at Shabbos: **'bris olam beini u'vein b'nei Yisrael'** (Shemos 31:17). **'Im lo brisi yomam va'lailah, chukos shamayim va'aretz lo samti'** (Yirmiyahu 33:25) — **'chukos shamayim va'aretz'** = the galgalim depend on bris."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Emunah kiyum via bris** (Teh 89:29; Shem 31:17 "bris olam"; Yir 33:25 "im lo brisi... chukos shamayim" = galgalim depend on bris).
intermediate.he: **ג. קיום אמונה דרך ברית** (תה' פט, כט; שמ' לא, יז "ברית עולם"; יר' לג, כה "אם לא בריתי... חוקות שמים" = גלגלים תלויים בברית).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. תה' פט, כט; שמ' לא, יז; יר' לג, כה.

beginner.en: **"ד. **Yisurim b'drachim = from galgalei ha'rakia** — nothing below without a star above. Some stars grow herbs where they shine; some make roads in their illuminated places; some make wilderness; some make settlement. The place's conduct = per kochvei hisnotzetzus. **'Darchei Tziyon aveilos mi'b'li ba'ei mo'ed'** (Eichah 1:4) — **mo'ed = Shabbos**."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Yisurim b'drachim from galgalei ha'rakia** (stars above govern herbs/roads/wilderness/settlement per their hisnotzetzus). "Darchei Tziyon aveilos" (Eichah 1:4) — **mo'ed=Shabbos**.
intermediate.he: **ד. ייסורים בדרכים מגלגלי הרקיע** (כוכבים למעלה מושלים עשבים/דרכים/מדבר/ישוב). "דרכי ציון אבלות" (איכה א, ד) — **מועד=שבת**.

beginner.en: **"ה. **2 bechinos of bris**: **Avraham** (ila'ah) and **Eliezer** (tata'ah). **Avraham = bris ila'ah = rakia mavdil bein mayin ila'in l'mayin tata'in**. **Ben chorin** — **'ashrecha eretz she'malkech ben chorin'** (Kohelet 10:17). **Eved toldin** — **'v'es ha'nefesh asher asu b'Charan'** (Bereshis 12:5). Cherus tied to bris: **'b'dam brisech shilachti asirayich mi'bor'** (Zechariah 9:11)."** **"Eliezer = bris tata'ah = **'ki shmi b'kirbo'** (Shemos 23:21) — 'shmo k'shem rabo' (Sanhedrin 38b) = **Metatron** = **shmiras issur v'heter** (as opposed to bris ila'ah which is shmiras bris kodesh)."**

intermediate.en: **ε. 2 brisos**: **Avraham=bris ila'ah=rakia mavdil** + ben chorin (Koh 10:17; Ber 12:5; Zech 9:11). **Eliezer=bris tata'ah=Metatron** ("shmi b'kirbo," Shem 23:21; San 38b "shmo k'shem rabo").
intermediate.he: **ה. ב' בריתות**: **אברהם=ברית עלאה=רקיע מבדיל** + בן חורין (קה' י, יז; בר' יב, ה; זכ' ט, יא). **אליעזר=ברית תתאה=מטטרון** ("שמי בקרבו", שמ' כג, כא; סנ' לח: "שמו כשם רבו").

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. קה' י, יז; בר' יב, ה; זכ' ט, יא; שמ' כג, כא; סנ' לח:.

beginner.en: **"**Bris ila'ah** = shmiras ha'bris kodesh. **Bris tata'ah** = shmiras issur v'heter. Must have both: be a **tzaddik + lamdan**. **'Lo am ha'aretz chasid'** (Avos 2:5). Tzaddik = via shmiras ha'bris (Zohar Noach 59b); lamdan = via issur v'heter."**

intermediate.en: Bris ila'ah=bris kodesh. Bris tata'ah=issur v'heter. Need both: **tzaddik+lamdan** (Avos 2:5 "lo am ha'aretz chasid"; Zohar Noach 59b).
intermediate.he: ברית עלאה=ברית קודש. ברית תתאה=איסור והיתר. דרוש שניהם: **צדיק+למדן** (אבות ב, ה; זוה"ק נח נט:).

scholarly.he: אבות ב, ה; זוה"ק נח נט:.

beginner.en: **"Moed Katan 17: **'im ha'rav domeh l'malach Hashem tzva'os, yevakshu Torah mi'pihu'** — must be tzaddik+lamdan. **Malach = lamdan = Metatron** (bris tata'ah). **Tzva'os = 'os hu b'tzava d'ilei'** — bechina of tzaddik = os bris (Ra'ya Mehemna Pinchas 236a; Chagigah 16a). Wherever tzaddik is mentioned, bris tata'ah is included — lower always included in higher (**'yadcha tachas yerechi'**)."**

intermediate.en: MK 17: "malach Hashem tzva'os" → **malach=lamdan=Metatron; tzva'os=os b'tzava=tzaddik=os bris** (RM Pin 236a; Chag 16a). Lower included in higher.
intermediate.he: מו"ק יז: "מלאך ה' צבאות" → **מלאך=למדן=מטטרון; צבאות=אות בצבא=צדיק=אות ברית** (רע"מ פינ' רלו; חג' טז). תחתון כלול בעליון.

scholarly.he: מו"ק יז; רע"מ פינ' רלו; חג' טז.

beginner.en: **"ו. One in bechina of bris — **'chesed mis'galei b'puma d'amah'** (Idra Nasa 142a): **'l'olam eshmar lo chasdi u'vrisi ne'emenes lo'** (Tehillim 89:29). Therefore chesed was given to **Avraham** — **rosh la'ma'aminim + rosh la'nimolim**."** **"When chesed (= **ahavah + hishtokekus**) is revealed — **'ki cholas ahavah ani'** (Shir 2:5) — he does **nefashos** — **'es ha'nefesh asher asu'** (Bereshis 12:5): makes **nekudos to the letters of Torah**. Osiyos without nekudos are like a **guf without nefesh** (as known). Nekudos to osiyos = nefesh to guf."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Bris-person → chesed revealed** (Idra Nasa 142a; Teh 89:29). Avraham=rosh ma'aminim+nimolim. Chesed=ahavah+hishtokekus (Shir 2:5) → osei nefashos=**nekudos to osiyos Torah** (osiyos w/o nekudos=guf w/o nefesh).
intermediate.he: **ו. בעל ברית → חסד נגלה** (אדרא נשא קמב.; תה' פט, כט). אברהם=ראש מאמינים+נמולים. חסד=אהבה+השתוקקות (שה"ש ב, ה) → עושה נפשות=**נקודות לאותיות התורה** (אותיות בלי נקודות=גוף בלי נפש).

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. אדרא נשא קמב.; תה' פט, כט; שה"ש ב, ה.

beginner.en: **"ז. Not enough to have **hishtokekus b'lev alone** — one must **bring the longings forth with the lips**. This is why tefilos were instituted. By hishtokekus b'lev, the **nefesh and nekudos become b'ko'ach**; when he brings out his hishtokekus with his mouth, they become **b'po'al**. Essential **motza ha'nefesh is from the mouth** — **'nafshi yatz'ah v'dibro'** (Shir 5:6). Therefore **'Torah y'vakshu mi'pihu'** (Mal'achi 2:7) — **mi'pihu dayka**. Targum on **'va'yehi ha'adam l'nefesh chayah'** (Bereshis 2:7): **'l'ru'ach memal'la'** — ikkar nefesh = from dibbur."**

intermediate.en: **η. Not just lev-hishtokekus — bring to lips** (tefilos). Lev=b'ko'ach; pi=b'po'al. "Nafshi yatz'ah v'dibro" (Shir 5:6); "Torah y'vakshu mi'pihu" (Mal 2:7); "l'nefesh chayah" → Targum **"l'ru'ach memal'la"** (Ber 2:7).
intermediate.he: **ז. לא די בהשתוקקות בלב — להוציא בשפתיים** (תפילות). לב=בכוח; פה=בפועל. "נפשי יצאה בדברו" (שה"ש ה, ו); "תורה יבקשו מפיהו" (מל' ב, ז); "לנפש חיה" → ת"א **"לרוח ממללא"** (בר' ב, ז).

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. שה"ש ה, ו; מל' ב, ז; בר' ב, ז.

beginner.en: **"ח. **'Yesh hevel asher na'asah al ha'aretz'** (Kohelet 8:14) = bechina of **gilgulei nefashos**. When one longs for a thing and brings out his longing with the **hevel of his mouth** — a nefesh is made. This nefesh (= ru'ach memal'la) goes in the air, reaches another person, **arouses him to longing** per its quality. From tzaddik to rasha → rasha gets hirhurei teshuvah (**'resha'im she'magi'a aleihem k'ma'aseh ha'tzaddikim'**). Opposite: from rasha to tzaddik can fell the tzaddik."**

intermediate.en: **θ. "Yesh hevel... al ha'aretz"** (Koh 8:14)=**gilgulei nefashos**: longing→mouth-hevel→nefesh travels air→arouses another ("resha'im... k'ma'aseh ha'tzaddikim"). Reverse: rasha fells tzaddik.
intermediate.he: **ח. "יש הבל... על הארץ"** (קה' ח, יד)=**גלגולי נפשות**: השתוקקות→הבל פה→נפש נעה באוויר→מעוררת אחר ("רשעים... כמעשה הצדיקים"). היפך: רשע מפיל צדיק.

beginner.en: **"ט. One at **Avraham's madreigah** (ba'al nefesh) — all his eating/seudos in bechina of **lechem ha'panim**. **'His'halech l'fanai'** (Bereshis 17:1): **his'halech**=raglayin=parnasah (**'es ha'yekum asher b'raglayhem,'** Devarim 11:6; San 110a = **'zeh mamono shel adam she'ma'amido al raglav'**). **'His'halech l'fanai'**=raglayin become **panim**. **'Lechem cham b'yom hilak'cho'** (Shmuel I 21:7) = lechem ha'panim = warm bread — **chemedas ha'nefesh**."**

intermediate.en: **ι. Avraham-madreigah**: all eating=**lechem ha'panim** ("his'halech l'fanai," Ber 17:1 — raglayin→panim; "b'raglayhem," Dev 11:6; San 110a parnasah; Sh"A 21:7 lechem cham).
intermediate.he: **ט. דרגת אברהם**: כל אכילה=**לחם הפנים** ("התהלך לפני", בר' יז, א — רגליים→פנים; "ברגליהם", דב' יא, ו; סנ' קי פרנסה; ש"א כא, ז לחם חם).

scholarly.he: סעיף ט. בר' יז, א; דב' יא, ו; סנ' קי; ש"א כא, ז.

beginner.en: **"**Peirush Savei d'Bei Asuna**: **'is lan beira b'dvara, ileih l'masa'**. **Beira = bar u'mazon** — which is **outside, behind kedushah** — **'v'histarti panai meihem.'** **Ileih l'masa** = **l'fanim** = lechem ha'panim. **Aiti pa'arei, shada l'hu** — **pa'arei = Shabbos emunah**: Rashi on **'es Hashem he'emarta va'Hashem he'emir'cha'** (Devarim 26:17-18) = lashon of **pa'arei v'shevach** — we glorify HKBH, we believe in Him, say **'Hashem echad.'** Shabbos=emunah=**tzedakah-shleimus**. **Afshilu chavlei d'pa'arei**: must tie the shleimus (lechem ha'panim, parnasah) with **ropes of Shabbos-emunah**."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: beira=bar u'mazon (outside); ileih l'masa=l'fanim=lechem ha'panim. **Pa'arei=Shabbos emunah** (Rashi Dev 26:17-18 "he'emarta"=pa'arei v'shevach). Must tie parnasah with **ropes of Shabbos-emunah**.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: בירא=בר ומזון (חוץ); עילוהו למתא=לפנים=לחם הפנים. **פארי=שבת אמונה** (רש"י דב' כו, יז-יח "האמרת"=פארי ושבח). לקשור פרנסה ב**חבלי שבת־אמונה**.

beginner.en: **R"N editorial**: **"This Torah was said on the pasuk **'va'yaseiv Elokim'** — 'ein hasavah ela se'udah' (Midrash Shemos Rabbah 20) = bechina of parnasah = bar u'mazon = **beira** (as explained). The **complete pasuk-peirush** per this Torah we did not merit to receive. (The greatness of **kisufin d'kedushah** mentioned above — I heard from his holy mouth earlier with greater elaboration, with additional chiddushim not recorded here; similarly **emunah** and other matters.)"**

intermediate.en: R"N: Torah said on "va'yaseiv Elokim" ("ein hasavah ela se'udah," ShR 20)=parnasah=beira. Full pasuk-peirush not received; kisufin/emunah heard more broadly from holy mouth.
intermediate.he: ר"נ: התורה על "ויסב אלוקים" ("אין הסבה אלא סעודה", שמ"ר כ)=פרנסה=בירא. פירוש הפסוק המלא לא התקבל; כיסופין/אמונה נשמעו יותר רחב.

beginner.en: **"Zivugan v'hitstarfusan of the **osiyos** is via **nekudos** — nekudos are the **chiyus + tenu'ah** of the letters. Without nekudos, osiyos = **gulem** (formless mass), no motion. Hence nekudos = nefesh: as nefesh is the chiyus of adam, and every motion is via nefesh — without it, body=gulem — so osiyos without nekudos = gulem. Via nekudos they **move**, **zivug**, **tzeruf**."**

intermediate.en: Osiyos' zivug+tzeruf via **nekudos**=chiyus+tenu'ah. Without nekudos=**gulem**. Nefesh↔nekudos analogy.
intermediate.he: זיווג+צירוף אותיות ע"י **נקודות**=חיות+תנועה. בלי נקודות=**גולם**. נפש↔נקודות.

beginner.en: **"**'Nekudos ha'kesef'** (Shir 1:11) — via **kisufin** (longings), **nekudos are made** = **nefesh**. Per his kisufin/hishtokekus — toward good or bad — so the osiyos in the thing are **shaped**. Every davar has osiyos, but without nekudos, letters have no tzurah. Per the kisufin, letters are shaped via the nekudos which are **nefesh received via kisufin**."**

intermediate.en: **"Nekudos ha'kesef"** (Shir 1:11): via **kisufin** nekudos=nefesh formed; shape osiyos per kisufin (good or bad).
intermediate.he: **"נקודות הכסף"** (שה"ש א, יא): ע"י **כיסופין** נקודות=נפש נוצרות; מעצבות אותיות לפי הכיסופין (טוב/רע).

beginner.en: **"**'Malach Hashem Tzva'os'** (Mal'achi 2:7). Chagigah 15a: on **Acher** — **'mai chazi? Chazei Metatron d'ka yasiv...'** — Acher reasoned (wrongly) about Metatron. **R' Akiva darsh: Hashem Tzva'os shmo — os hu b'tzava shelo.** Therefore the rav needs both bechinos: **malach = Metatron** and **Hashem Tzva'os**. Thus **domeh l'malach Hashem Tzva'os** — then one can draw near to learn Torah from his mouth."**

intermediate.en: **"Malach Hashem Tzva'os"** (Mal 2:7; Chag 15a Acher/Metatron; R"Akiva "os hu b'tzava shelo"): rav needs **malach+Tzva'os** = lamdan+tzaddik-bris.
intermediate.he: **"מלאך ה' צבאות"** (מל' ב, ז; חג' טו אחר/מטטרון; ר"ע "אות הוא בצבא שלו"): רבי דרוש **מלאך+צבאות** = למדן+צדיק־ברית.

beginner.en: **"**'Tori zahav na'aseh lach im nekudos ha'kesef'** (Shir 1:11). **Zahav = zivug** — **'mi'tzafon zahav ye'eseh'** (Iyov 37:22); **'is'arusa d'zivuga mi'sitra di'smala'** = **tzafon** (Zohar Vayeshev 186b). **'Tori zahav na'aseh lach'** — letters of Torah are **zivuged + tzeirufed** via nekudos ha'kesef (made from kisufin/hishtokekus → nefashos = nekudos). Via kisufin → zivug."**

intermediate.en: **"Tori zahav... nekudos ha'kesef"** (Shir 1:11): zahav=zivug (Iyov 37:22 "mi'tzafon zahav"; Zohar Vayeshev 186b — zivuga mi'smala=tzafon). Torah-letters zivuged via nekudos (from kisufin).
intermediate.he: **"תורי זהב... נקודות הכסף"** (שה"ש א, יא): זהב=זיווג (איוב לז, כב "מצפון זהב"; זוה"ק וישב קפו: — זיווגא מסיטרא דשמאלא=צפון). אותיות תורה מזדווגות דרך נקודות (מכיסופים).

scholarly.he: שה"ש א, יא; איוב לז, כב; זוה"ק וישב קפו:.

beginner.en: **"Klal ha'davar: **kisufin v'hishtokekus l'davar she'bi'kdushah are very precious**. Via them, nefesh is formed, completed via dibbur, goes out and travels. Sometimes the kedushah-nefesh travels into a **rasha**, who has hirhurei teshuvah and can return him to tov. Conversely: the kisufin **l'davar ra**, cha'v, cause great damage — the nefesh from bad kisufin travels into the **tzaddik** and can cause him to sin, cha'v."** **"This = **'yesh hevel asher na'asah al ha'aretz'** — **hevel = nefashos made from kisufin**."**

intermediate.en: **Klal**: **kisufin l'kedushah** very precious → nefesh → dibbur → travels → reforms rasha. Opposite: bad kisufin → nefesh travels into tzaddik → can cause sin. "Yesh hevel..."=nefashos from kisufin.
intermediate.he: **כלל**: **כיסופין לקדושה** יקרים → נפש → דיבור → נודד → מתקן רשע. היפך: כיסופים רעים → נפש נודדת לצדיק → מביאתו לחטא. "יש הבל..."=נפשות מכיסופים.

beginner.en: **"Shayach above: one who thinks **lamdan alone is ikar** is bechina of **Acher she'kitzetz b'neti'os** — one can be **lamdan and rasha gamur**. So too even tzaddikim sometimes fall from their madreigah (impossible to stay permanently at one level). When falling, if he tries to **hold onto his lamdan** remaining — not good; rather hold onto **yir'as shamayim** still present from the **reshimu** that remained."**

intermediate.en: Lamdan alone=Acher (**"kitzetz b'neti'os"**: lamdan+rasha possible). Tzaddik falling: don't hold **lamdan-remainder** but **yir'as shamayim reshimu**.
intermediate.he: למדן לבד=אחר (**"קיצץ בנטיעות"**: למדן+רשע אפשרי). צדיק בנפילה: לא לאחוז **בלמדן** אלא ב**יראת שמים/רשימו**.

beginner.en: **"**Shleimus of all matters is emunah**; without emunah, all lack. BB 9b: **'ha'nosein prutah misbareich b'shesh, v'ha'm'fayso b'achas esreih'** — both cases lack **one** (should be 7+12). Because **emunah=Shabbos**, and tzedakah reaches shleimus only on Shabbos — the missing **1+1 = Shabbos's bechina**, which completes 6→7 and 11→12."**

intermediate.en: **Shleimus=emunah**; without it lack. BB 9b 6+11 (missing 1+1). Shabbos=emunah completes: 6→7 kochvei lechet; 11→12 mazalos.
intermediate.he: **שלמות=אמונה**; ללא חסר. ב"ב ט: 6+11 (חסר 1+1). שבת=אמונה משלימה: 6→7 כוכבי לכת; 11→12 מזלות.

beginner.en: **R"N editorial**: **"All this we heard at first without complete explanation and connection — and all matters are now well-explained in the Torah **'is lan beira'** above. **'Gavra d'ozif v'reichaya d'tevira'** (the next ma'amarim of Savei d'Bei Asuna) — we did not merit to hear Torah upon them. But from his words I heard: he wanted to reveal Torah on **all the ma'amarim** there, and also on the whole **ma'aseh** of how R' Yehoshua ben Chananya conducted himself with them — how he came, how he dealt with them afterward — and he spoke with me a little..."**

intermediate.en: R"N: heard first without peirush; clarified in T31. **Gavra d'ozif + reichaya d'tevira** (next Savei ma'amarim) — no Torah received. Rabbeinu intended full commentary on all, including **whole ma'aseh of R' Yehoshua**.
intermediate.he: ר"נ: שמענו תחילה בלי פירוש; התבאר בת"ל. **גברא דאוזיף + רחיא דתבירא** (המאמרים הבאים) — לא זכינו. רצה לגלות על **הכל**, כולל **המעשה של ר"י**.

beginner.en: **Closing doxology** (editorial): **"Ha'pa'am nodeh es Hashem b'gilah b'rinah, asher zachinu l'sayem Savei d'Bei Asuna — devarim ha'setumim v'chasumim b'elef izkoim, ein chochmah v'ein tvunah..."** — thanksgiving for completing Savei d'Bei Asuna. Prayer to merit publishing the remaining ma'amarim that reveal **'darkei avodaso yisbarech bi'drachim nifla'im,'** pillars founded on pure gold. Now we lift our hands to Hashem in plea and tefilah to complete the work.

intermediate.en: Closing doxology: thanks for completing Savei d'Bei Asuna; plea to publish the rest of the awesome ma'amarim revealing avodah b'derech niflah.
intermediate.he: חתימה: תודה על סיום סבי דבי אתונא; בקשה להשלים יתר המאמרים הנוראים המגלים דרכי עבודה נפלאה.
